svg.title: Replacing a conclusion
svg.desc: The intention make timing easy to read stays unchanged. Its earlier conclusion, show tasks on a weekday timeline, and the implementation node below it are drawn dashed and marked D for deleted. A new conclusion, list milestones by date, and its implementation are marked A for added. A second conclusion of the same intention, highlight what moved since the last version, and its implementation stay as they are. Git keeps the deleted branch in its history.
